title: Proteomics shows a J-type head is alpaca bone

tellings.quote: I ran these all of these bone samples from the skull through this pipeline and they all came back identified as alpaca bone.

plain: Bone from the skull of one of the three-fingered bodies from Peru, a head of the so-called J type, came back as alpaca bone when tested by proteomics, a method that identifies species from the proteins in a sample. An anonymous proteomics expert says on the show that every sample "came back identified as alpaca bone", and points to a paper in Nature on identifying species in ancient bone and another on CT scans showing the brain case resembles an alpaca's.
